  279|       |        if (matching_contexts.empty()) {
  280|       |          return std::make_shared<generic::List<InterpretationContext>>();
  281|       |        }
  282|       |      }
  283|       |    }
  284|       |
  285|       |    // Convert vector to ListSP
  286|       |    auto result = std::make_shared<generic::List<InterpretationContext>>(
  287|       |        matching_contexts);
  288|       |    return result;
  289|       |  }
  290|       |  bool operator==(const InterpretationContainer<Value>& other) const {
  291|       |    if (this->size() != other.size()) return false;
  292|       |    std::vector<size_t> unmatched_indexes(this->size());
  293|       |    for (size_t i = 0; i < this->size(); ++i) {
  294|       |      unmatched_indexes[i] = i;
  295|       |    }
  296|       |    auto our_items   = this->items();
  297|       |    auto other_items = other.items();
  298|       |    for (size_t i = 0; i < our_items->size(); ++i) {
  299|       |      const auto& our_pair = our_items->at(i);
  300|       |      bool        matched  = false;
  301|       |      for (size_t j = 0; j < other_items->size(); ++j) {
  302|       |        if (std::find(unmatched_indexes.begin(), unmatched_indexes.end(), j) ==
  303|       |            unmatched_indexes.end()) {
  304|       |          continue;
  305|       |        }
  306|       |        const auto& other_pair = other_items->at(j);
  307|       |        if (*our_pair->first() == *other_pair->first()) {
  308|       |          if (!compare_value(our_pair->second(),
  309|       |                             other_pair->second(),
  310|       |                             generic::category::is_shared_ptr<
  311|       |                                 typename std::remove_reference<
  312|       |                                     decltype(our_pair->second())>::type>())) {
  313|       |            return false;
  314|       |          }
  315|       |          matched = true;
  316|       |          unmatched_indexes.erase(
  317|       |              std::remove(
  318|       |                  unmatched_indexes.begin(), unmatched_indexes.end(), j),
  319|       |              unmatched_indexes.end());
  320|       |          break;
  321|       |        }
  322|       |      }
  323|       |      if (!matched) {
  324|       |        return false;
  325|       |      }
  326|       |    }
  327|       |    return true;
  328|       |  }
  329|       |  bool operator!=(const InterpretationContainer<Value>& other) const {
  330|       |    return !(*this == other);
  331|       |  }
  332|       |};

  491|       |const std::shared_ptr<HDF5Data> HDF5Data::from_communications(
  492|       |    const messages::MeasurementRequestSP&        request,
  493|       |    const messages::MeasurementResponseSP&       response,
  494|       |    const voltage_states::DeviceVoltageStatesSP& device_voltage_states,
  495|       |    const boost::uuids::uuid&                    session_id,
  496|       |    const std::string&                           measurement_title,
  497|       |    const int&                                   unique_id,
  498|      1|    const int&                                   timestamp) {
  499|       |  // Compile all waveforms in the request
  500|      1|  generic::List<instrument_interfaces::Waveform> waveforms =
  501|      1|      *request->waveforms();

  503|      1|    wave->space()->space()->compile();
  504|      1|  }

  506|       |  // Find a valid waveform
  507|      1|  instrument_interfaces::WaveformSP valid_waveform;

  509|      1|    auto dSpace = waveform->space();

  511|      1|      valid_waveform = waveform;
  512|      1|      goto found_waveform;
  513|      1|    }
  514|      1|  }
  515|      0|  throw std::runtime_error("No valid waveform found in request.");
  516|      1|found_waveform:

  518|       |

  520|      1|  auto domain_labels = dSpace->axes();
  521|       |
  522|       |  // Build axes
  523|      1|  int              count = domain_labels->size();

  525|      1|  std::iota(axes_vec.begin(), axes_vec.end(), 0);
  526|      1|  math::AxesSP<int> axes = std::make_shared<math::Axes<int>>(axes_vec);
  527|       |
  528|       |  // Build unit_domain
  529|      1|  math::AxesSP<math::arrays::ControlArray> unit_domain =
  530|      1|      dSpace->space()->create_array(axes);
  531|       |
  532|       |  // Build shape
  533|      1|  const auto&      shape_sz = unit_domain->at(0)->shape();
  534|      1|  std::vector<int> shape(shape_sz.begin(), shape_sz.end());
  535|      1|  auto             shape_axes = std::make_shared<math::Axes<int>>(shape);
  536|       |
  537|       |  // Ranges from response
  538|      1|  auto ranges = response->arrays();
